title: Restricted eval key record with item-level rubric (one JSONL line of eval_keys.jsonl)
description: RESTRICTED: real DEV/VALIDATION records carry answer keys and must stay in isolated evaluation artifacts (agentsLog/Pewciu6/private/), never in model-facing input, training, retrieval, or a public PR. Only synthetic fixtures are committed.

id.description: Stable id, joins to runner input and model output by equality.

era.description: e.g. ancient, medieval, early_modern, 19th_century, interwar, ww2, prl, post_1989, multi

modality.description: image = item relies on visual material (vision/OCR slice).

official_rules.description: RESTRICTED: official scoring-rule text for the item (reviewer use only).

expect_abstention.description: True when the correct behaviour is to abstain (unanswerable item).

expected_years.description: Years that a correct answer may state; any other stated year flags chronology.

distractors.description: Plausible wrong entities; naming one on a failed entity criterion flags entity_confusion.

official_points_ref.description: Locator in the official scoring rules document, e.g. 'zasady p.5 zad.3'. No quoted text.

citation_fail_max_points.description: Cap on points when a required citation is missing/unsupported.

points_by_met_count.description: e.g. {'3':2,'2':1}: points from the number of met criteria (CKE graded true/false items).

all_or_nothing.description: Full points only if every criterion is met.

gate.description: If this criterion fails, the item scores 0 (e.g. wrong 'Rozstrzygnięcie').

options.description: decision: all possible decisions; naming two or more = hedged = fail; naming another = fail; none found = review.

pair.description: e.g. ['1','F'] for true/false statements; accepts prawda/falsz; hedged '1 P F' fails.

min_words.description: Met if the response has at least this many words.

zeroes.description: criterion_ids forced to 0 when this criterion fails.

review_on_fail.description: A lexical miss routes to review (needs_review) instead of a hard fail.

any_of.description: Met if any phrase appears (diacritic/case-folded, whole-word).

all_of.description: Met only if all phrases appear.

manual_only.description: Heuristic cannot judge; route to human/independent review.
